decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line feature note [ev-6d7e63820de1]. It says the eks:eks-cluster-name tag is added and the karpenter.sh/managed-by annotation is removed. It does not say which resources carry the tag or the annotation, what reads them, or what happens to an environment that relied on the annotation. None of the other Features items in the section context address this change [ev-cb56353c3c4e, ev-6ec6b4ea132d], and no upgrade-guide text is shown. So the proposed behavior-change statement, including "anything matching the old annotation will no longer find it", is a guess. Settling the consequence needs the upgrade guide or the PR #6589 description saying what used the annotation or tag and whether anything breaks (for example tag-based IAM or discovery).
